verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਿਤ ਸਰਦ ਨਿਸਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: sobhit saradh nis jagamag jot sas pratham sahelee kahai prem ras chaakheeaai ||

en.bdb: Note: Abandon bashfulness and enjoy the love of the beloved husband at the time of meeting Him. It is a wintry night and the Moon is spreading its light all around. A friend of the holy congregation urges to obtain Guru's sermons in order to enjoy the elixir of Lord husband's love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਆਏ ਹੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ  ਮਿਲੀਐ ਨਿਰੰਤਰ ਹੁਇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: pooran kirapaa kai terai aae hai kirapaa nidhaan  mileeaai nira(n)tar hui a(n)tar na raakheeaai ||

en.bdb: And when the clement Lord in His complete blessings comes and rests on your bed-like heart, then meet Him without any reservations and inhibitions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਭਿਲਾਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh ras lubhit hui man madhukar sukh sa(n)paT bhilaakheeaai ||

en.bdb: May the frolicsome mind remain longing for the fragrant dust of the lotus feet of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਈ ਲਜਾਇ ਪਾਈਐ ਨ ਪੁਨਿ ਪਦਮ ਦੈ ਪਲਕ ਅਮੋਲ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗ ਮੁਖ ਸਾਖੀਐ ॥੩੪੮॥
verses.translit_en: joiee lajai paieeaai na pun padham dhai palak amol pria sa(n)g mukh saakheeaai ||348||

en.bdb: Guru-conscious persons testify that any seeker bride who remains shy and bashful at the time of meeting with husband Lord, loses that rare opportunity. She is then unable to obtain the invaluable moment even after spending countless money. (348)
